description: Hand-written gold labels for the 17 synthetic documents in data/synthetic_docs. All parties, clauses and dates are fictional. Labels were written by reading each document, not by running the system.

holiday_calendar.name: England and Wales bank holidays (subset relevant to test windows), per LPA Section 1.1 'Business Day' definition

obligation_cases.tests: Baseline LPA clause that applies to all LPs

obligations.source_quote: The General Partner shall deliver unaudited quarterly financial statements to each Limited Partner within sixty (60) calendar days following the end of each fiscal quarter.

The General Partner shall provide Investor LP-A with unaudited quarterly financial statements and a portfolio exposure schedule within forty-five (45) calendar days following the end of each fiscal quarter.

obligation_cases.tests: ESG report with a soft condition ('where reasonably available')

conditions: Portfolio-level emissions information where reasonably available
obligations.source_quote: The General Partner shall provide Investor LP-B with a quarterly ESG report within sixty (60) calendar days following the end of each fiscal quarter.

obligation_cases.tests: No numeric deadline ('as soon as practicable'); system must not invent one

obligations.trigger: Following the end of each fiscal quarter
obligations.source_quote: The General Partner shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide Investor LP-C with additional portfolio information as soon as practicable following the end of each fiscal quarter.

obligation_cases.tests: Business-day deadline across a year-end bank holiday

obligations.source_quote: The General Partner shall provide Investor LP-D with a monthly cash flow statement and capital account movement schedule within ten (10) business days following the end of each calendar month.

obligation_cases.tests: Out of scope: event notification, not periodic reporting. Expect zero reporting obligations
Deadline in words only ('fifteen Business Days'), capitalised defined term, crosses Easter

deliverables: Valuation summary for each Portfolio Company
obligations.source_quote: The General Partner shall deliver to Investor LP-F a valuation summary for each Portfolio Company within fifteen Business Days after the end of each calendar quarter.

obligation_cases.tests: One clause, two obligations with different frequencies; number in words above 100

obligations.source_quote: (a) a capital account statement within forty-five (45) calendar days after the end of each fiscal quarter; and
obligations.escalation_reason: Investor LP-G is named in the clause lead-in, not in the sub-paragraph quote; the investor check correctly asks for confirmation.

deliverables: Audited annual financial statements of the Fund
obligations.source_quote: (b) audited annual financial statements of the Fund within one hundred and twenty (120) calendar days after the end of each fiscal year.
obligations.escalation_reason: Same as above: investor named only in the lead-in.

obligation_cases.tests: Distractor clauses (MFN, fee) plus an event-triggered reporting deadline

deliverables: Audited financial statements of each Portfolio Company
obligations.trigger: General Partner receives the audited financial statements of a Portfolio Company
obligations.source_quote: The General Partner shall provide Investor LP-H with a copy of the audited financial statements of each Portfolio Company within thirty (30) calendar days after the General Partner receives those audited financial statements.

obligation_cases.tests: Side letter overrides LPA ('Notwithstanding Section 7.1'); precedence is a legal question

obligations.source_quote: Notwithstanding Section 7.1 of the Limited Partnership Agreement, the General Partner shall deliver unaudited quarterly financial statements to Investor LP-I within ninety (90) calendar days following the end of each fiscal quarter.
obligations.known_gap: No cross-document conflict check: the register will hold both the LPA 60-day and the LP-I 90-day record without flagging that they cover the same deliverable.

amendment_cases.tests: 'deleted and replaced with' phrasing; already in seeded register
amendment_cases.source_quote: With effect from 1 January 2026, the reference to "forty-five (45) calendar days" in Clause 4.2 of the LP-A Side Letter is deleted and replaced with "thirty (30) calendar days".

amendment_cases.tests: 'changed from X to Y' phrasing; already in seeded register
amendment_cases.source_quote: With effect from 1 January 2026, the deadline in Clause 3.1 of the LP-B Side Letter is changed from sixty (60) calendar days to seventy-five (75) calendar days following the end of each fiscal quarter.

amendment_cases.tests: Hard line breaks inside the operative sentence (PDF-style layout)
amendment_cases.source_quote: With effect from 1 January 2027, the reference to "thirty (30) calendar days" in Clause 4.2 of the LP-A Side Letter is deleted and replaced with "twenty-five (25) calendar days".

amendment_cases.tests: Unit change: business days to calendar days
amendment_cases.source_quote: With effect from 1 April 2026, the reference to "ten (10) business days" in Clause 6.1 of the LP-D Side Letter is deleted and replaced with "fifteen (15) calendar days".

amendment_cases.tests: Relative change ('extended by a further 15 days'); new value is not written in the document
amendment_cases.source_quote: With effect from 1 July 2026, the period for delivery of the quarterly ESG report under Clause 3.1 of the LP-B Side Letter, as previously amended, is extended by a further fifteen (15) calendar days.
amendment_cases.blocked_reason: Both 75 and 90 are computed, not stated. The design routes computed contractual values to a human instead of letting the model do arithmetic.

amendment_cases.tests: Frequency change, not a deadline change
amendment_cases.source_quote: With effect from 1 July 2026, the portfolio exposure schedule referred to in Clause 4.3 of the LP-A Side Letter shall be delivered monthly rather than quarterly.
amendment_cases.blocked_reason: Only deadline replacements can be applied automatically; the candidate must be kept for manual handling.

amendment_cases.tests: US date format; amendment for an investor with no record in the register
amendment_cases.source_quote: With effect from January 1, 2027, the deadline in Clause 2.1 of the LP-J Side Letter is changed from sixty (60) calendar days to forty-five (45) calendar days.
